It is not part of the proposed material for evaluation in this publication; mappings, target artefacts and profiling details are expected to evolve in subsequent iterations of this guide.

Yellow row/cells: In this ballot publication, some row/cells of the mapping table have been left in yellow to indicate areas requiring further review or refinement; including feedback from the Xt-EHR joint action (see note above). These highlights will be addressed in subsequent updates to ensure accuracy and completeness of the mappings.

body.p: This page explains how elements from the CancerConditionAtDiagnosis logical model are expressed in the FHIR Resources CancerConditionAtDiagnosisEuCcm/ObservationHistologyBehaviourEuCcm resource used by this Implementation Guide.

tr.td: Must refer to a PatientEuCcm patient profile.

ObservationHistologyBehaviourEuCcm is used to define the histology behaviour. Here the code of the observation is fixed: code = $sct#395531003 "Neoplasm observable (observable entity). The histology behaviour is then noted in the valueCodeableConcept element. The CancerConditionAtDiagnosisEuCcm profile references the Observation in extension[HistologyBehaviour]
Here the ICD03 codesystem is recommended by the WG community, but the most specific code if required to use.
Defines the classification system for the tumour grading.
Represents the measured grade. Here the text element of the CodeableConcept is filled out. If a code is available, it can be entered through the CodeableConcept.
When the date of the clinical visit is available, this extension should be used
When the date of the biopsy supporting the diagnosis is available, this extension should be used
When the date of the imaging supporting the diagnosis is available, this extension should be used
When the date of the laboratory report supporting the diagnosis is available, this extension should be used
